title: Export and imported history
pdfHelp: Backups exclude original PDFs by default. Including PDFs verifies each selected file and shows its size before creation.
sensitive: Excerpts, extracted text and research history may contain sensitive information.
permission: Every export and historical read uses current source permissions. Gaps represent omitted content that is no longer available.
csvHelp: CSV keeps typed numbers numeric. Text that could start a spreadsheet formula receives a leading apostrophe. Empty values retain their explicit processing state; units, conditions, evidence and original review state are included.
selectStudies: Select bibliography studies (up to 100 per export)
estimate: Preview size includes research data; ZIP container overhead is measured when the artifact is created.
nativeScope: Native Zotero translator; bibliographic metadata only. Abstracts, extra fields, notes, annotations, attachment paths and attachment URLs are excluded. Original compound identities are listed below.
incomplete: Incomplete metadata: review these records before citing
importWarning: Restore creates imported research history only. It does not approve decisions locally, restore credentials, schedule jobs, publish notes or modify Zotero.
mappingHelp: Review every original-to-destination mapping. Exact existing compound identities are suggested; other profiles and items require an explicit choice. Original evidence stays unchanged.
confirm: I reviewed these profile, library, item and content mappings
mappingFailed: The mapping could not be completed. Discard this preview and inspect the archive again before changing the mapping.
historyHelp: Original values, evidence, authors and immutable version links are preserved. Opening original evidence requires current mapped access and matching indexed document bytes.
question: Question
empty: No imported history in this snapshot.
noLocalApproval: This is a historical record; its original review state grants no local authority.
